description: Mirror-state model for the rust-primary campaign (#539 rust-primary-mirror-state). One entry per tool: the primary edition, the other edition's state, and the parity check that enforces parity when the mirror state is parity. The engine resolver (common/bin/engine-resolver) reads the generated validation/editions.tsv (one tab-separated line per tool, regenerated by scripts/check_editions.py --write-tsv and checked against this file on every validation run) and refuses an explicit request for a paused, archived, or absent mirror; scripts/check_editions.py proves this file matches the tracked entrypoints and the Rust agentctl python-only subcommand lists. Mirror states: parity (kept in lockstep by the named parity check), paused (mirror frozen; paused_at names the commit), archived (mirror retained read-only, no catch-up planned), absent (no such edition).

tools.name: agentctl
tools.note: Rust is primary since the engine-rust-default switch. The subcommands below are the exceptions: they are python-primary with no Rust edition yet, and the Rust edition refuses them by name (rs/agentctl/src/cli.rs PYTHON_ONLY_COMMANDS and PYTHON_ONLY_CHAT_COMMANDS). Fleshing them out is campaign milestone 2: chat history and chat context (adapter transports) moved to Rust in #545 rust-primary-agentctl-chat-readers; chat launch moved to Rust in M2 rust-primary-agentctl-chat-launch (generation B: launches the current Rust bridge; the retired Python polling launcher is archived, not mirrored, and its config/state formats are refused with a pointer to 'chat init').

subcommands.name: migrate
subcommands.note: Headless-worker migration; stays python-primary until the herdr-subagents port carries it (coordinator decision, #545).

subcommands.name: repair
subcommands.note: Headless-worker operation; stays python-primary until the herdr-subagents port carries it (coordinator decision, #545).

tools.name: herdr-chat
tools.note: Standalone chat-bridge entrypoint (agentctl.chat). The Rust agentctl chat subcommand covers run/status/reply/close but not launch/history/context; see the agentctl subcommands.

tools.name: herdr-subagents
tools.note: Headless foreign-harness workers; the Rust agentctl refuses headless workers with a pointer to this Python edition.

tools.name: parallel-experiment-runner
tools.note: Python-only; last in the campaign port order (milestone 5).

tools.name: wrkslots
tools.note: Python-primary CLI. The Rust edition grows in rs/wrkslotsd subcommand by subcommand (#562 rust-primary-wrkslots) at differential parity for readers and fixture-guarded writers; it is reachable only through the opt-in WRKSLOTS_ENGINE=rust (default still Python) until the coordinator-approved primary flip. Commands the Rust edition has not ported refuse by name rather than falling back.

tools.name: wrkslotsd
tools.note: Rust observer/CLI growing into the wrkslots Rust edition (#562 rust-primary-wrkslots); it replays EVENTS logs and validates the durable file formats at differential parity with the Python loader: parse-config and validate-config (.wrkslots.yml), parse-state (ACTIVE shard), parse-archive (ARCHIVED shard), parse-handoff (generation-bound sidecar), parse-hold, and parse-journal (every recovery-journal kind). Every mutating command remains Python-primary until the edition flip; reachable as the wrkslots Rust edition through WRKSLOTS_ENGINE=rust and directly as rs/bin/wrkslotsd.

tools.name: wrkviz
tools.note: Python-primary; the Rust edition grows in rs/wrkviz subcommand by subcommand (#706 rust-primary-wrkviz) at differential parity: inspect, query list, query show for team/agent/phase/rollup references, query stats, query prompts/messages, query search including message:/tool: show references, serve, quickstart, extract-transcripts (schema 3 and schema 1; the schema-2 generation is not yet ported and refuses by name) over synthetic corpora, and ingest-claude-history, Codex ingest, Claude ingest, Muse ingest, and Orc ingest (the shared ingest writer: snapshot store, payload store, artifact catalog, site identity) over history, rollout, session, and SQLite fixtures. Commands the Rust edition has not ported refuse by name. Static site assets carry over to the Rust edition when it becomes primary.

tools.name: agent-teams
tools.note: Rust-only crate (rs/agent-teams); no tracked bin symlink and no Python edition. Listed so the inventory is complete.

tools.name: local-ci-hub
tools.note: Python-only; delegates canonical digest to a configured external command when present.
